# Empty intake templates

These files are header-only preparation, not approved sources, grants, stock,
products or executable database migrations. Fill them in verified private
project storage; never commit supplier details, agreements, customer data,
credentials or filled operational registers into this public repository.

`source-register.csv` identifies an access/use review. `product-intake.csv`
captures candidates and facts; it is not the public response contract.
`media-grants.csv` separates publication channels and media permissions.
Evidence fields hold private record references, not raw documents or secrets.

Importing an item does not publish it. Validation, deduplication, factual/media
review and explicit batch approval precede the published projection. A missing
manufacturer reference or grant stays unresolved rather than being invented.
Prepare the model/variant match before creating stable internal identities.

See [execution roadmap](../EXECUTION-ROADMAP.md).
